milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the nether brick structure (center approximately at [0, 3, 13] spawn-relative) and face it. The structure spans z=10-16 relative to spawn, so the center is at z=13, y=3 (midpoint of 5-block height). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance since the structure is clearly visible, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_cobblestone_stairs with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an iron pickaxe (provided via /give) which is required to get the drop. The item name in inventory is 'mossy_cobblestone_stairs' (plural, matching the block ID). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
